senses.gloss:
शबर शबर, अस्, m. = शवर, q. v., N.
of a wild mountaineer tribe; N. of the author of
the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 169 (having the patronymic
Kākṣīvata); epithet of a Buddhist.
—शबर-
भाष्य, अम्, n. Śabara's commentary on the Mī-
māṃsā-sūtra.
—शबर-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a king
(mentioned in the Kathārṇava).
—शबर-स्वामिन्,
ई, m., N. of the author of a Bhāṣya or commentary
on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtras of Jaimini, (this Bhāṣya
has been critically annotated by the great Mīmāṃsā
authority Kumārila.)
—शबरालय (˚र-आल्˚), अस्,
m. the abode of savage tribes.

शाबर शाबर, अस्, m., N. of the commen-
tary written by Śabara-svāmin; of a work by Prāṇa-
kṛṣṇa; of a Tantra work ascribed to Śiva.
—शाबर-
भाष्य, अम्, n. the commentary written by Śabara-
svāmin.

शबल शबल, अस्, आ, अम् (see शवल), varie-
gated, brindled; (ई), f. a spotted cow; Kāma-
dhenu the cow of plenty (identified with the varying
powers of nature).
—शबली-होम, अस्, m. an offering
to the cow Śabalī.

सबल स-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, powerful, strong;
accompanied by a force or army.
—स-बलानुग
(˚ल-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, with an army and followers.

शब्द् शब्द्, cl. 10. P. (more properly to
be regarded as a Nom. fr. शब्द below),
शब्दयति (sometimes also A. शब्दायते, Pāṇ. III.
1, 17, but see शब्दाय, शब्दायमान), -यितुम्,
to sound, make any noise or sound; to utter any
sound or cry, call out, call, speak; शब्दापयति,
-यितुम्, to address, speak to: Pass. शब्द्यते, to be
sounded, &c.

शब्द, अस्, m. (in the Upaniṣads also अम्, n.;
thought by some to be connected with rt. 3. शप् +
2. द), sound, noise; a sound; a word, significant
word; (in gram.) a declinable word (as a noun,
pronoun, &c.); grammar; verbal communication,
oral evidence, verbal authority (as one of the Pra-
māṇas, see प्र-माण).
—शब्द-कार, अस्, ई, अम्,
making noise or sound, sounding, sonorous.
—शब्द-
कोष, अस्, m. ‘word-repository,’ a dictionary, voca-
bulary.
—शब्द-कौस्तुभ, ‘word-jewel,’ N. of
a commentary by Bhaṭṭoji on the Mahā-bhāṣya.
—शब्द-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, being or residing in a
word (as a poetical or metaphorical meaning).
—शब्द-गुण, अस्, m. the quality of sound; a
particular quality or style of speech.
—शब्द-ग्रह,
अस्, m. perceiving or catching sound; the ear; a
fabulous arrow.
—शब्द-ग्राम, अस्, m. the compass
or range of sound.
—शब्द-चन्द्रिका, f. ‘elucidation
of words,’ N. of a lexicon by Cakra-pāṇi-datta.
—शब्द-चातुर्य, अम्, n. skill in words, cleverness
of diction, eloquence.
—शब्द-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
various or fanciful in sound (as poetry).
—शब्द-
चोर, अस्, m. ‘word-thief,’ a plagiarist.
—शब्द-ज,
अस्, आ, अम्, arising from sound, produced by words,
by verbal communication.
—शब्द-तन्मात्र, अम्,
[]
n. the subtile element of sound.
—शब्द-नित्यत्व,
अम्, n. the eternity of sound.
—शब्द-निर्णय,
अस्, m. ‘word-investigation,’ N. of a work by Vāca-
spati-miśra.
—शब्द-पति, इस्, m. ‘word-lord,’ a
mere nominal sovereign, (according to Malli-nātha
शब्दत एव पतिर् न त्व् अर्थतः, Raghu-v. VIII.
51.)
—शब्द-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flying with a sound,
making a noise in flight (said of an arrow); falling
with a sound.
—शब्द-प्रमाण, अम्, n. verbal
testimony or proof, oral evidence.
—शब्द-प्राछ्,
ट्, ट्, ट्, enquiring after (the meaning of) a word.
—शब्द-बोध, अस्, m. (in phil.) knowledge (de-
rived) from verbal testimony.
—शब्द-ब्रह्मन्, अ,
n. ‘word-spirit,’ i. e. the Veda considered as a revealed
word or sound and identified with Brahman, the
Supreme Spirit.
—शब्द-भेद, अस्, m. difference
or distinction of sound.
—शब्द-भेद-प्रकाश,
अस्, m., N. of an appendix to the Viśva-prakāśa (con-
taining a list of words similar in sound but different
in meaning).
—शब्द-भेदिन्, ई, m. ‘sound-piercer,’
epithet of Arjuna [cf. शब्द-वेधिन्]; the anus; a
particular fabulous arrow (which pierces an object
the sound of which only is heard).
—शब्द-मात्र,
अम्, n. sound only, a mere sound.
—शब्द-माला, f.
‘a collection of words,’ N. of a lexicon by Rāme-
śvara-śarman.
—शब्द-योनि, इस्, f. ‘word-source,’
the source or origin of a word, a radical word, root.
—शब्द-रत्न, अम्, n. ‘word-jewel,’ N. of a
lexicon.
—शब्द-रत्नाकर (˚न-आक्˚), अस्, m.
‘mine of word-gems,’ N. of a dictionary of syno-
nyms by Mahīpa.
—शब्द-रत्नावली (˚न-आव्˚), f.
‘word-necklace,’ N. of a lexicon of synonyms by
Mathureśa.
—शब्द-लिङ्गार्थ-चन्द्रिका (˚ग-
अर्˚), f. ‘elucidation of the gender and meaning of
words,’ N. of a lexicon.
—शब्द-विरोध, अस्, m.
opposition of words in a sentence.
—शब्द-विशेष,
अस्, m. difference or variety of sound; (आस्), m. pl.
the varieties of sound, (these the Sāṅkhya arranges
according to the accents उदात्त, अन्-उदात्त, स्व-
रित, and the notes of the gamut, as षड्ज,
ऋषभ, गान्धार, मध्यम, पञ्चम,
धैवत, निषाद, &c., q. q. v. v.)
—शब्द-विशे-
षण, अम्, n. (in grammar) the attribute of a word,
an adjective.
—शब्द-वृत्ति, इस्, f. (in rhetoric) the
function of a word.
—शब्दवेधि-त्व, अम्, n. capa-
bility of piercing (an invisible object) the sound (of
which only is heard).
—शब्द-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
sound-piercing, piercing or terrifying enemies by
mere shouts; (ई), m. an archer who can pierce an
invisible object the sound of which only is heard; a
warrior who pierces his enemies by mere shouts;
epithet of Arjuna; of king Daśa-ratha.
—शब्द-
वैलक्षण्य, अम्, n. difference in word, verbal
difference (as opposed to अर्थ-वैलक्षण्य or
real difference).
—शब्द-शक्ति, इस्, f. the force or
signification of a word.
—शब्द-शब्दार्थ-मञ्-
जूषा (˚द-अर्˚), f. ‘a collection of words and their
meanings,’ N. of a lexicon.
—शब्द-शासन, अम्, n.
a rule or law of grammar.
—शब्द-शास्त्र, अम्,
n. ‘science of words,’ rules of grammar, any gram-
matical treatise, grammar, philology.
—शब्द-शुद्-
धि, इस्, f. purity or accuracy of language, correct use
of words.
—शब्द-श्लेष, अस्, m. play upon words,
verbal equivoque, a rhetorical ornament by which
the same words are used in different senses, punning.
—शब्द-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. a collection of words,
vocabulary, lexicon.
—शब्द-सिद्धि, इस्, f. ‘the
complete use of words,’ a section of the Kāvya-kalpa-
latā-vṛtti-parimala.
—शब्दाडम्बर (˚द-आड्˚),
अस्, m. high-sounding words, verbosity, confusion of
words, bombast.
—शब्दातीत (˚द-अत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
beyond the reach of sound (used as an epithet of
the deity).
—शब्दादि (˚द-आदि), इस्, m., scil. वि-
षय, the objects of sense beginning with sound,
(these are शब्द, sound; स्पर्श, tangibility; रूप,
form; रस, savour; गन्ध, odour; see विषय.)
—शब्दादि-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having the quality
of sound, &c., (see विषय.)
—शब्दाधिष्ठान
(˚द-अध्˚), अम्, n. ‘receptacle of sound,’ the ear.
—शब्दाध्याहार (˚द-अध्˚), अस्, m. the supply-
ing of a word (to complete an ellipsis).
—शब्दानु-
[]
रूप (˚द-अन्˚), अम्, n. conformity to sound, imita-
tion of sound.
—शब्दानुशासन (˚द-अन्˚), अम्,
n. ‘word-instruction, word explanation,’ the giving
rules for words (used as a title of Pāṇini's grammar);
N. of a grammatical work by Abhinava-śākaṭāyana;
of a work on grammar by Hema-candra.
—शब्दाब्-
धि (˚द-अब्˚), इस्, m. ‘ocean of words,’ N. of a
lexicon (compiled by order of Prāṇa-kṛṣṇa).
—शब्-
दार्णव (˚द-अर्˚), अस्, m. ‘ocean of words,’ N. of
a lexicon.
—शब्दार्थ (˚द-अर्˚), अस्, m. the sense
or meaning of a word; (औ), m. du. a word and
its sense.
—शब्दार्थ-कल्पतरु, उस्, m. ‘Kalpa-
tree of the meaning of words,’ N. of a lexicon by
Veṅkaṭa.
—शब्दालङ्कार (˚द-अल्˚), अस्, m. verbal
ornament, rhetorical use of words (as alliteration
&c.).
—शब्दालोक-रहस्य and शब्दालोक-विवेक
(˚द-आल्˚), N. of two philosophical commentaries.
—शब्देन्दु-शेखर (˚द-इन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
work by Nāgeśa-bhaṭṭa.

शाब्द शाब्द, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शब्द), sonorous,
sounding; relating to sound, (opposed to आर्थ,
q. v.); relating to or derived from words; verbal,
oral; nominal (as inflection); (अस्), m. a philologist,
grammarian; (ई), f. Sarasvatī (as goddess of speech
and eloquence).
—शाब्द-बोध, अस्, m. ‘verbal
knowledge,’ apprehension of the meaning of words,
perception of the verbal or literal sense (of a sen-
tence, &c.).
—शाब्द-व्यञ्जना, f. (in rhetoric)
suggestion or insinuation founded on words (as op-
posed to आर्थ-व्यञ्जना or suggestion dependent
upon the meaning of words).

शब्दयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making a sound, sound-
ing.

शब्दाय [cf. rt. शब्द् above], Nom. A. शब्दा-
यते, -यितुम्, to make a noise, sound, cry; to bray:
Caus. शब्दाययति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound.

शब्दायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, making a
noise, crying out.

शब्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, made to give out
a sound (as a musical instrument &c.); uttered,
articulated; called; explained; made public or
manifest; converted into a noun; (अम्), n. noise,
cry, the braying (of an ass).

शाब्दिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to sounds or words;
making a noise, sounding; verbal; (अस्), m. one
skilled in words, a philologist, grammarian.
—शाब्-
दिक-नरसिंह, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.
सबधूक स-बधूक. See स-वधूक.

सबन्धु स-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, possessed of
a friend, befriended; being of the same family;
closely connected or united; (उस्), m. a kinsman,
relation.

सबर्दुघ सबर्-दुघ, सबर्-धु. See under
सबस्.

सबलि स-बलि, इस्, इस्, इ, endowed with
royal revenue; accompanied by the Bali offering;
(इस्), m. evening twilight (this being the proper
hour for offering food to spirits, &c.; see बलि).

सबस् सबस् (changeable into सबर् before
soft consonants; cf. सपस् under rt. सप्), Ved.
water, heavenly food, nectar, (Sāy. = उदक, पयस्,
अमृत; cf. Gr. σέβας, ‘worship’ or ‘the object of
worship.’)
—सबर्-दुघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. yielding
or granting heavenly food or water, dispensing water.
—सबर्-दुह्, -धुक्, क्, क्, Ved. yielding nectar.
—सबर्-धु, Ved. = सबर्-दुह् above.

सबहुमानम् स-बहुमानम्, ind. with great
honour or reverence, very respectfully.

सबाध् स-बाध्, त्, m., Ved. an oppressor,
destroyer, one who is oppressed; a sacrificer who is
disturbed by enemies, (Sāy. = शत्रुभिर् बाधितो
यजमानः, Ṛg-veda I. 64, 8; = बाधा-सहित,
Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 18); a priest, (in Naigh. III. 18.
सबाधः is enumerated among the ऋत्विङ्-ना-
मानि.)

स-बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, painful, hurtful; extor-
tionate, oppressive.

स-बाधस्, Ved. according to Sāy. स-बाधसस्
= दारिद्र-निमित्त-बाध-सहितस्य, having the
suffering caused by poverty, Ṛg-veda V. 10, 6.

सबान्धव स-बान्धव, अस्, आ, अम्, having
kindred, connected, related.

सबालवृद्ध स-बाल-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, with
children and old men.

सबीभत्सम् स-बीभत्सम्, ind. with abhor-
rence.

सब्रह्मक स-ब्रह्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, together
with Brahmā, together with (the world of) Brahmā.

सब्रह्मचर्य स-ब्रह्मचर्य, अम्, n. fellow-
studentship, studying together or being disciples of
the same teacher.

स-ब्रह्मचारिन्, ई, m. a fellow-student, one
engaged in the same studies and observing the same
austerities.
साब्दी साब्दी, f. a sort of grape.
